class FlowNet:
    __slots__ = ('n', 'adj', 'head', 'cap', 'tail', 'arc_of_pair')

    def __init__(self, n):
        self.n = n
        self.adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]   # arc ids leaving each vertex
        self.head = []                      # arc -> from
        self.tail = []                      # arc -> to
        self.cap = []                       # arc -> residual capacity
        self.arc_of_pair = {}               # (u, v, label) -> arc id (unused)

    def add(self, u, v, cap):
        """Add directed arc u->v with integer capacity; returns its id."""
        aid = len(self.cap)
        self.head.append(u)
        self.tail.append(v)
        self.cap.append(cap)
        self.adj[u].append(aid)
        rev = aid + 1
        self.head.append(v)
        self.tail.append(u)
        self.cap.append(0)
        self.adj[v].append(rev)
        return aid
